statement: Golden food goes in the food slot and gives bonuses without being consumed; the more you have the bigger the bonus.
More copies of the same golden food give diminishing returns on damage and AFK gains and accuracy.
Listed farm locations are his personal opinion; other spots exist but aren't worth listing; asks viewers to comment.
Golden nages give damage and are best farmed at Bored Beans with Divine Knight on a crystal farm build.
Golden jam gives health percent and is best farmed at World 1 Coliseum with Divine Knight on a drop rate build.
Golden peanuts give mining efficiency percent and are craftable; obtained through the Journeyman quest line.
Hot dogs also drop at Bored Beans where you already crystal farm; two birds one stone.
Golden kebabs give damage percent and are farmed at World 2 Coliseum with Divine Knight on a drop rate build.
Golden meat pie gives defense percent; best farmed from sand castles or sandy pods with Divine Knight crystal farm build; sandy pods also give glass shards.
Butter bars give accuracy and come from catching the butterflies where legendary Bandit Bob lives.
Strongly suggests focusing on drop rate and AFK gains when farming butter bars to go smoothly.
Golden bread gives money percent and is obtained at World 3 Coliseum with Divine Knight on a drop rate build.
Golden cheese gives shrine leveling percent and golden yeti ham gives skill XP percent; both farmed efficiently at Blood Bones with Divine Knight crystal build.
Other good places for these two are Bop Boxes and Rams and Yeti Tunes?
Gold ribs give fishing efficiency percent and are best farmed at Clammies? with Divine Knight crystal farm build.
Golden grilled cheese gives all stat percent and golden hampter gives sailing AFK chance; farm both with Divine Knight crystal build at Citrons.
Citrons if you can maintain only one statue; Tremor Worms if you can maintain two statues.
Golden nigiri gives XP percent and is best farmed at Leek Spirits? with Divine Knight crystal farm build.
Golden dumplings give AFK gain percent and are best farmed at Mini Chieftains with Divine Knight crystal farm build.
Two video links in the description teach crystal farming drop rate.
Coliseum tickets are farmable in the post office; Cosmic Carrier (box order 6) sometimes has an order reward giving a Coliseum ticket.
With resources this is 100% farmable: get 3D prints for all Cosmic Carrier orders and silver pen skip all orders except the Coliseum ticket ones.
Skipping other orders with silver pens avoids insane ramping costs.
At end of day leave an order incomplete and use a silver pen on a shield to take it away; after daily reset you are back at zero for more tickets.
In World 2 Coliseum don't run minus mine because it affects the skilling nodes; their health is so high they won't despawn and you can fail by waiting.
Before entering Coliseum make sure the Divine Knight orb is off cooldown to get maximum loot.
Coliseum chests count as monsters so the orb affects them.
Divine Knight is the best golden food farmer by a long shot.
You can have six golden food slots total: two at start; two from World 3 merit upgrades (second and fourth purchase); last two from gem shop.
Active combat: grilled cheese and kebabs; add golden bread for bossing.
AFK combat: grilled cheese and kebabs and dumplings.
Mining: grilled cheese and jam and peanuts and dumplings.
General skilling: just grilled cheese and dumplings.
Fishing: grilled cheese and dumplings plus ribs.
Jade Emporium unlocks the Bean Stock structure for jade coins from sneaking; dropping a 10K stack of a golden food makes it account bound for every character.
You can buy Bean Stock upgrades to drop 100K of a golden food for even more bonuses; very strong mechanic.
Must drop 10K first then 100K per unique golden food; cannot skip tier; 110K per food is the cap; one and done.
Cannot double dip with upgrades but can have the 100K bonus and still equip golden food on your character: free stats.
Top of the Bean Stock UI shows total golden food bonus listing all sources of golden food effect percent.
Orange cauldron bubble Shimmeron gives golden food effect percent.
Sigil Emoji Veggie? gives golden food effect percent.
Chilled yarn artifact in sailing increases golden food effect bonus even more.
Shaman's family bonus is a golden food effect multiplier so level Shaman as high as you can.
Golden apple stamp in misc tab rewarded for Mutton 7 billion figure quest gives massive golden food percent in exchange for golden nages.
A bribe unlocked through Jorum? gives another 10% golden food effect.
World 1 achievement Nutty Crafter requires crafting 42 golden peanuts for 5% golden food effect.
Rare drop from Eant? in World 2 called Royal Turban gives 15% golden food effect.
Serif star sign Beanie Major gives 20% golden food effect.
Star Sign doubler chip from World 4 can double the star sign bonus.
Serif cosmos gives 1.1 times bonus per 20 summoning levels for golden food.
Cooking meal Yumi Peach Ring gives a massive amount of golden food effect percent.
Sneaking charm Gumstick obtained at very low chance gives 50% golden food effect.
Warrior multiplies Shimmeron bubble thanks to Warrior's Rule.
Warriors get a talent called Hungry for Food that gives more golden food effect percent.
